Recorded claim:
Feed folder names trim whitespace and leading/trailing dots. Keep interior dots because they belong to hostnames and other useful text. Entry290 changed the old global-dot removal; current FeedUtils still has the anchored boundary expression. Test input whose meaningful punctuation is inside the name as well as at its edges.

Provenance: detailed-batch-288-317. Original evidence IDs: 86138b65c299aa3fade7e70b7bef22e557c142b7b6ba3d20186f3042cd29b0f2.

title: Recorded lesson: Sanitize only the forbidden edges of a feed folder name
